exposure: vNOTES hysterectomy (vaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery hysterectomy)
cohort: The study included 685 women who underwent vNOTES hysterectomy, with or without salpingo-oophorectomy, for benign or malignant gynaecological conditions across six specialised gynaecological centres.
finding: vNOTES hysterectomy was found to be a safe and effective surgical approach, demonstrating low rates of intraoperative (1.7%) and postoperative (1.4%) complications.
